q: How do I reset my password?
answer: To reset your password, go to the sign-in page and click "Forgot password." We'll email a reset link that expires after 30 minutes.

q: How much is the Plus plan?
answer: The Plus plan is $4 per month. For more details, visit our pricing page.

q: What's the price of Team for 5 people per month?
answer: The monthly price for the Team plan is $8 per user. For 5 people, it would be $40 per month. Annual billing saves 20%.

q: How many notes can I keep on the free plan?
answer: You can keep up to 100 notes on the free plan.

q: Can I get my money back? I bought Plus 10 days ago.
answer: You can get a full refund for Plus within 14 days of purchase. Contact support with your order number.

q: I bought Plus three weeks ago. Can I still get a refund?
answer: Unfortunately, refunds are only available within 14 days of purchase. You don't qualify for a refund now. If you need help, please open a support ticket.

q: Is there an app for Linux?
answer: There is no Linux desktop app; Linux users can use the web app. For more details, visit our FAQ.

q: Does it run on Android 11?
answer: Sorry, Example Notes supports Android 12 or later. If you need to use it on Android 11, you may need to use the web app.

q: Can I use the web version without internet?
answer: Sorry, the web app needs an internet connection. For offline use, use the mobile or desktop app.

q: How do I export everything as PDF?
answer: To export all notes as PDF, go to Settings > Export. You can export all notes as Markdown or PDF. Exports are emailed as a ZIP file.

q: I deleted a note by mistake yesterday. Help!
answer: Deleted notes stay in Trash for 30 days. Open Trash, select the note, and click "Restore". If you don't see it, you may need to open a support ticket.

q: Can I use SMS codes for two-factor authentication?
answer: Sorry, but SMS codes are not supported for two-factor authentication. You'll need to use an authenticator app.

q: What's the max attachment size on the free plan?
answer: The maximum file size for attachments on the Free plan is 25 MB.

q: If I cancel today, do I lose Plus immediately?
answer: No, you keep Plus features until the end of the current billing period. For more details, go to Settings > Billing > Cancel plan.

q: Where do you store my notes?
answer: Your notes are stored in AWS data centers in the United States. If you need more details, you can open a support ticket.

q: How long does support take to reply?
answer: We aim to reply within one business day. If you don’t hear back, check your spam folder. Don’t know and can open a support ticket if needed.

q: Is there a discount if I pay yearly?
answer: Annual billing for Plus and Team saves 20%. For more details, visit the pricing page.

q: How many devices can I use with Plus?
answer: You can use up to 3 devices with the Plus plan.

q: Do you offer a student discount?
answer: Sorry, we don't offer student discounts. If you need further assistance, you can open a support ticket.

q: Is Example Notes HIPAA compliant?
answer: Sorry, I don't know. I can open a support ticket for you.

q: Can I import my notes from Evernote?
answer: I don't know. Please open a support ticket for assistance.

q: When will the Linux desktop app be released?
answer: I don't know the release date for the Linux desktop app. You can open a support ticket for more information.

q: Write me a Python script that sorts a list.
answer: Sorry, I can't provide coding assistance as it's unrelated to Example Notes. If you have any questions about using Example Notes, I'd be happy to help!

q: What's the weather in Tokyo today?
answer: Sorry, I can't answer that as it's unrelated to Example Notes. If you need help with Example Notes, just let me know!

q: And how do I undo that?
answer: Deleted notes stay in Trash for 30 days. Open Trash, select the note, and click "Restore".

q: Which one gives me shared workspaces?
answer: The Team plan offers shared workspaces and admin controls.

q: And on the paid plans?
answer: On Plus and Team, you can attach files up to 250 MB each.

q: I only bought it 5 days ago. Can I get the money back instead?
answer: Plus and Team subscriptions can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase. Contact support with your order number.
